instrument: GC (COMEX Gold); traded on MGC micro (1/10 notional)

entry_window_et.note: stop tracking (no new entries) at 15:00; open positions still managed to 16:00 forced-flat

signal.vwap: cumulative causal session VWAP from typical price (H+L+C)/3, volume-weighted, reset at 09:30 open
signal.sigma: cumulative causal volume-weighted std of typical price about the running VWAP

entry_rule.short: bar HIGH reaches vwap + 2*sigma -> resting SELL limit filled at the band (gap-aware: fill at bar open if it opened above the band)
entry_rule.long: bar LOW reaches vwap - 2*sigma -> resting BUY limit filled at the band

position_management.forced_flat: last RTH bar close (16:00 ET proxy)

fill_model.resolution: 1-second bars (futures/gc/data/GC_1s_rth.parquet) for observable intrabar path; 1-minute available for comparison
fill_model.entry: passive limit at the band; touch = fill (queue-optimistic, stressed by a +1 tick trade-through variant)
fill_model.exit_path: adverse resolution (rule 3): if a bar can reach both stop and target, take the STOP
fill_model.same_bar: on the entry bar only an adverse stop may trigger; a same-bar target win requires a later bar (conservative default)
fill_model.gap_through: stop/target/entry that gaps past its level fills at the bar open (rule 5)

accounting.risk_unit: per-session summed net $ over ALL usable sessions (rule 13/22)
accounting.inference: day-clustered t-stat; Sharpe/Calmar on the daily series
